promotion_note: Promotion means a gold pack may be considered for moving a training config from governance scaffold to current for research experiments only. It does NOT mean clinical validation, diagnosis/treatment readiness, predictive accuracy, or that a production GBM-BERT model exists. Thresholds assume mixed human-reviewed evidence plus real external NER/relations (e.g. BioRED GBM-filtered).

rationale.min_examples_per_task: Minimum volume for PMID-safe train/validation/test splits after real-corpus merge; evidence remains human-gated while NER/relations may include external_corpus rows.
rationale.min_examples_per_label: Avoid single-digit per-label floors that overstate multi-class readiness.
rationale.min_source_pmids: Reduce overfit to a small abstract set and keep leakage audits meaningful once external corpora are mixed in.

warning: Research-use only. Not medical advice. Not intended for diagnosis, treatment selection, or clinical decision-making.
